name: Thermora
tagline: Enterprise-grade climate care, engineered for the individual home.
positioning: Thermora coordinates certified HVAC technicians, maintenance records, and system diagnostics into a single managed service for homeowners.

hero.h1: Your home's climate, managed like an enterprise asset.
hero.sub: Thermora assigns your residence a dedicated service record, schedules certified technicians, and forecasts system failures before they cost you a summer afternoon.

features.title: Unified system ledger
features.description: Every furnace, condenser, and thermostat logged with model numbers, warranty dates, and full service history in one authoritative record.

features.title: Predictive maintenance windows
features.description: Runtime and refrigerant telemetry flags degrading components weeks early, so we dispatch before a breakdown becomes an emergency call.

features.title: Vetted technician dispatch
features.description: Only NATE-certified contractors, credential-verified and rated on prior visits, are cleared to enter your service queue.

features.title: Scheduled seasonal tune-ups
features.description: Spring cooling and fall heating inspections are booked automatically around your calendar and confirmed 72 hours ahead.

features.title: Transparent quote review
features.description: Every proposed repair is itemized with parts pricing and a plain-language second opinion before you approve a dime.

features.title: Same-day priority routing
features.description: Comfort emergencies escalate to the front of the regional dispatch board with a guaranteed response window.

testimonials.quote: We inherited a house with three thermostats and zero paperwork. Thermora reconstructed the entire system history in a week and caught a failing blower before winter. It reads like an audited report.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Halloran

testimonials.quote: I manage six rental units and used to chase invoices across five contractors. Now every visit, quote, and warranty lives in one ledger. My accountant actually thanked me.
testimonials.name: Devon Ashby

testimonials.quote: The predictive alert flagged low refrigerant on our heat pump in March. A technician was scheduled before we noticed anything. That is the level of foresight I expect and rarely get.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

pricing.blurb: Digital system ledger and annual inspection for a single residence.
Proactive care with predictive diagnostics and priority scheduling.
Portfolio-wide coverage for owners of multiple residences.

homepage.footerBlurb: Thermora is a managed climate-care service for homeowners who expect their household systems handled with corporate discipline.
